_readme: ALLOWLIST MANIFEST — copy to manifest.json and edit.
Every seriesId below is a PLACEHOLDER. No real CEIC series IDs are shipped in this
repository: CEIC IDs are subscription-specific and inventing them would produce
silent garbage. Open CDMNext, find each indicator, copy its series ID, and paste it
in place of the <...> token. collector.py skips (and warns about) every entry whose
seriesId still looks like a placeholder.
FIELDS
seriesId   (required) CEIC series ID / mnemonic from CDMNext.
label      Human label stored in the China Monitor catalog.
unit       Free text, e.g. 'RMB bn', '% pa', '%YoY'.
frequency  Daily | Weekly | Monthly | Quarterly | Annual — drives the staleness budget.
geo        Country/region label.
source     The ORIGINAL statistical agency (PBoC, NBS, CFETS, ...), not 'CEIC'.
logicalId  Optional. Binds this CEIC series to a China Monitor registry series so
it flows straight into the dashboards, strategy report, and PPTX deck.
Must be a real registry ID (GET /api/series) or an 'imported:<id>' ID.
Leave null to keep the series in the catalog only — it is still
addressable as imported:<seriesId> and can be mapped later in the UI.
transform  Optional: raw | yoy | divide_1000 | divide_100 | multiply_100.
The six entries below are the highest-value CEIC-only indicators for this product:
total social financing, DR007, SHIBOR, property sales, retail sales, and industrial
profits. Only shibor_3m, retail_sales_yoy, policy_rate_7d and property_starts_ytd
exist in the current registry; the other two are catalog-only until you map them.

series.label: China: Total Social Financing: Stock
series._note: TSF has no free fallback anywhere in China Monitor — this is the single highest-value CEIC series. Catalog-only until mapped; reachable as imported:<seriesId>.

series.label: China: Interbank Repo Rate: DR007 (7-day, depository institutions)
series._note: Maps onto the existing 7-day policy rate slot. Daily frequency ⇒ 10-day staleness budget; if the collector stops running, China Monitor falls back automatically.

series.label: China: Commodity Building Sales: Floor Space Sold: YTD YoY
series._note: Replace the logicalId with a dedicated property-sales registry ID if one is added; property_starts_ytd is the closest existing slot.

series.label: China: Retail Sales of Consumer Goods: YoY
series._note: AKShare/NBS already cover this. A fresh CEIC import wins; a stale one steps aside automatically.

series.label: China: Industrial Enterprise: Total Profit: YTD YoY
series._note: No registry slot yet — catalog-only, addressable as imported:<seriesId>, or map it in Imports → CEIC once a logical ID exists.
